_comment: Identity providers Microsoft 365 domains federate to, by the registered domain of the sign-in URL's host. A federated domain whose sign-in URL has an /adfs/ path is self-hosted ADFS whatever its host; one matching none of these is recorded as 'other' (no finding).
_shared_sign_in: Registered domains of sign-in pages that many organisations share: a credential for one of them is provider context, not the organisation's own service.
